At midnight, every human on Earth loses the ability to lie. For twenty-four hours.
And the first person it ruins... is you.
Seven a.m. Your mom shows you her new haircut. You smile, open your mouth, and out comes... It looks like a helmet.
Nine a.m. Your boss asks why you're late. I was sitting in the parking lot, watching videos.
Noon. A politician steps up to give a press conference. It lasts four seconds.
Researchers estimate the average person tells one or two lies a day. Today, every single one is gone.
Dating profiles suddenly show real heights. A car salesman leans in and whispers, Honestly? Buy the cheaper one.
But then, at six p.m., your best friend asks, Are you okay?
And for the first time in years, you can't say I'm fine.
So you tell the truth. And they tell you theirs.
Midnight. The lies come back. Your phone buzzes. It's Mom.
I loved how honest you were today.
Would you survive twenty-four hours of truth? Tell me in the comments.
